{"tool":"write_file","arguments":{"path":"final_report.md","content":"# Security Evaluation Report

## Vulnerability: Insufficient Input Validation (Partial Match)

**File:** `src/filter.py`  
**Function:** `is_safe_name`  

### Description
The function uses `re.match()` with a regular expression `^[a-z]+` that only checks if the **beginning** of the string matches the pattern. Because it lacks an end-of-string anchor (`$`), any input that starts with one or more lowercase letters will be validated as safe, regardless of any trailing malicious characters or payloads.

### Remediation
Update the regular expression to include the end-of-string anchor `$` to ensure the entire input string conforms to the allowed character set.

**Corrected Code:**
```python
SAFE = re.compile(r'^[a-z]+$')
```"}}

# Security Evaluation Report

## Vulnerability: Insufficient Input Validation (Partial Match)

**File:** `src/filter.py`  
**Function:** `is_safe_name`  

### Description
The function uses `re.match()` with a regular expression `^[a-z]+` that only checks if the **beginning** of the string matches the pattern. Because it lacks an end-of-string anchor (`$`), any input that starts with one or more lowercase letters will be validated as safe, regardless of any trailing malicious characters or payloads.

### Remediation
Update the regular expression to include the end-of-string anchor `$` to ensure the entire input string conforms to the allowed character set.

**Corrected Code:**
```python
SAFE = re.compile(r'^[a-z]+$')
```
